President Donald Trump said on Friday ​that the US would penalize American companies that build data ‌centers overseas, a move he said is intended to help the US artificial intelligence sector compete with its Chinese counterparts.
"We're not going to allow our companies to build data ​centers outside of our country," Trump said while discussing AI at ​a White House news conference following his trip to Asia. ⁠He said he would impose a "tremendous tax" on companies that build data ​centers abroad.
